product_one_liner.value: Funnel helps marketing and data teams collect, prepare and share marketing data from hundreds of sources for reporting, AI-powered analysis and marketing measurement.

employee_band.notes: The company reports a global team of 300+ employees.

eng_blog.notes: Two architecture posts by CTO Jonas Björk explain the ingestion platform and data platform implementation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Product Engineer - AI Product Experience; the title explicitly includes AI and the responsibilities include production LLM applications.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the Funnel AI documentation, AI product and MCP pages, privacy/security material, engineering blog and subprocessor notifications. No underlying provider for customer-facing Funnel AI was identified; external MCP clients and internal developer tooling do not establish its model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims include SOC 2 Type 2 attestation and ISO 27001:2022 certification. GDPR is a claimed compliance framework, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced January 28, 2026: an $80 million debt facility replacing a prior $58 million arrangement; not an equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: Debt facility announced January 28, 2026, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public board lists one opening, Product Engineer - AI Product Experience, and no SDR, BDR or account executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The May 19, 2026 announcement introduces the Funnel MCP Server, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying company join or departure was verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The about page lacks a complete dated executive roster. Identified 2026 C-level appointments were internal promotions, not company joins, so they were not counted.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy notice explicitly identifies HubSpot for website visitor tracking, chat and sessions; product documentation also provides a HubSpot connector. This establishes a visible marketing-system signal, not proof that HubSpot is the internal sales CRM.
